items.title: Holy Mecca Cityscape and Kaaba Gate Vector File for CNC Plasma
items.description: A magnificent and spiritual double-panel gate design showcasing the holy cityscape of Mecca. It beautifully captures the Kaaba at the base, surrounded by the grand arches of the Holy Mosque, towering modern architectural landmarks including the Makkah Clock Tower, and a starry sky topped with elegant Islamic calligraphy.
